description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{U}{R}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Bloom Tender.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Bloom Tender.
Repeat.
